theme.title: Russell, Wilt and Baylor
theme.subtitle: The NBA in the 1960s
theme.recap: Boston won eight titles in a row while Wilt, Baylor and West put up numbers that look like misprints today.

questions.prompt: Starting in 1959, how many NBA titles in a row did Boston win?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston Celtics won eight in a row from 1959 to 1966.

funFacts.text: Boston's first title in the dynasty era came after sweeping the Minneapolis Lakers in the championship round.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Celtics won the NBA championship after sweeping the Minneapolis Lakers

funFacts.text: Coach Red Auerbach and defensive anchor Bill Russell built the core that dominated the league.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: led by coach Red Auerbach, acquired Bill Russell in 1956

funFacts.text: Russell later became Boston's player-coach and the first Black head coach in a major U.S. sport.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first African American head coach in any United States sport

questions.prompt: Elgin Baylor set the NBA single-game scoring record on November 15, 1960. How many points did he score?
questions.note: 71, a record until Wilt passed it the next season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On November 15 of the 1960–61 season, Baylor set an NBA scoring record when he scored 71 points in a victory

funFacts.text: Baylor's rookie arrival helped rescue a struggling Lakers franchise that had even considered shutting down.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Baylor immediately exceeded expectations and ultimately saved the Lakers franchise

funFacts.text: Earlier, Baylor refused to play a road game after a segregated hotel denied lodging to Black teammates.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Baylor refused to play in a road game in Charleston, West Virginia

funFacts.text: While serving in the Army Reserve, Baylor could travel to Lakers games only on weekend passes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he could play for the Lakers only when on a weekend pass

questions.prompt: In Game 1 of the 1969 Finals, how many points did Jerry West score against Boston?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He used this freedom to score 53 points on opposing guards

funFacts.text: Boston player-coach Bill Russell initially chose not to double-team West, giving the guard room to attack.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bill Russell decided not to double-team Lakers star guard Jerry West

funFacts.text: The opener changed hands repeatedly before Wilt Chamberlain finished the Celtics with a clutch late basket.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Wilt Chamberlain who sealed the game with a clutch basket

funFacts.text: West became the first—and still only—Finals MVP chosen from a team that lost the series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the only time in NBA Finals history that the MVP was awarded to a player on the losing team

questions.prompt: In the 1962 Finals, Bill Russell set the record for rebounds in a quarter. How many?
questions.note: 19 in one quarter, the most of any NBA quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Russell's 19 rebounds in a single quarter is the most of any NBA quarter

funFacts.text: Russell's rebounding feat came in an overtime Game 7 win over Los Angeles, not a regular-season game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: game 7 overtime victory

funFacts.text: Russell contributed major scoring as well as rebounding in that tense championship decider.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scored 30 points

funFacts.text: His career rebounding best had come against Syracuse, setting a mark for boards in a winning effort.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: set a still-standing record for rebounds in a winning effort

questions.prompt: In his record-setting rebounding game on November 24, 1960, how many rebounds did Wilt grab in one half?
questions.note: 31 in a single half, in a game his team lost.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Record set in a losing effort; grabbed 31 rebounds in one half; scored 34 points

funFacts.text: Wilt's record-setting rebounding game came against archrival Boston—but Philadelphia lost despite his dominance.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Record set in a losing effort

funFacts.text: Chamberlain also scored heavily in the record night, showing he could dominate both ends at once.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scored 34 points

funFacts.text: Earlier that same year, Wilt set a rookie rebounding record against Syracuse while scoring heavily, too.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Single-game record for a rookie; scored 44 points
